title: Power Automate process mining: custom KPIs in the process intelligence experience
notes: claim 52: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly treats process mining's documented security boundary as unconfirmed and suggests that users can hold the tenant-wide add-on instead of Power Automate Premium. The ownership navigation and the claim that other users are unaffected also need correction.

claims.claim: The feature enables custom formula-based KPIs in the process intelligence experience.
claims.quote: This feature enables you to define custom KPIs and metrics tailored to specific business requirements within the process intelligence experience.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The formula editor supports case attributes, event data, timestamps, existing metrics and mathematical operations.
claims.quote: Build new KPIs using an intuitive formula editor that supports calculations based on case attributes, event data, timestamps, and existing metrics.

claims.claim: Custom metrics can be modified or deleted.
claims.quote: Modify, refine, or delete custom metrics as business needs evolve

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Metric edits automatically propagate to every visualization using the metric.
claims.quote: with changes automatically reflected across all visualizations using those metrics.

claims.claim: Custom KPIs can be reused in visualization components and filters.
claims.quote: Reuse custom KPIs throughout the process intelligence experience, applying them to filters and analysis scenarios.

claims.claim: Custom metrics are evaluated against process data and stay current with each data refresh.
claims.quote: Custom metrics are evaluated dynamically against your process data, ensuring calculations remain current with each data refresh

claims.claim: Custom metrics support business-specific ratios, scores and cost calculations alongside standard metrics.
claims.quote: Define metrics that reflect your unique business context, such as weighted performance scores, custom cost calculations, compliance rates, or domain-specific efficiency ratios.

claims.claim: The process intelligence experience is a card-based dashboard.

claims.claim: The process intelligence experience replaces the earlier process overview.

claims.fix: Replace 'the card-based dashboard that replaces the earlier process overview' with 'a card-based dashboard that enhances the previous process overview'.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; changes; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not yet provide a guide to creating custom KPIs specifically in this experience.
claims.quote: Searched: "process intelligence experience" "custom" "KPI" formula metrics; "process intelligence" "custom KPIs". Opened studio KPI card, overview and tab-management pages; results describe standard cards or desktop custom metrics, not this feature.

claims.claim: The KPI card page lists Frequency, Performance, Rework and Finance as example metric types.
claims.quote: Select the metric type to display (for example, Frequency, Performance, Rework, or Finance).

claims.claim: Learn documents custom metrics for the Process Mining desktop app.
claims.quote: The custom metric editor indicates the result is applicable everywhere in the Power Automate Process Mining desktop app.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented that desktop custom-metric rules also describe this experience's custom KPIs.
claims.quote: Searched: "process intelligence experience" "custom" "KPI" formula metrics. Opened desktop Basic examples, studio overview and KPI card pages; no passage connects the desktop formula rules to this feature.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: No feature-specific admin enable/disable switch or required admin action is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate process intelligence custom KPI enable disable admin restrict security roles Dataverse API; "process intelligence" custom KPIs "admin" "pac" PowerShell. Opened studio overview, KPI card and security pages; no feature-specific switch found.

claims.claim: Custom KPIs do not add a data source.
claims.quote: Searched: "process intelligence" "custom metrics" security roles admin switch data source. Opened studio overview and KPI card pages; neither states that custom KPIs cannot add a source. The record describes existing process data, not an exhaustive source restriction.
claims.fix: Replace 'It does not add a data source, but a formula can surface an attribute' with 'The roadmap describes calculations over existing process data; a formula could surface an attribute'. Keep the wider-sharing scenario explicitly as risk analysis.

claims.claim: Process sharing is with individual users, not Microsoft Entra groups.
claims.quote: Process mining currently doesn't support sharing for Microsoft Entra groups.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout

claims.quote: Make public: Share the tab with other users (indicated by person icon with lock).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not describe custom-KPI-specific behavior when a tab is public or a process is shared.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate process intelligence custom KPIs public tabs permissions rollout. Opened tab-management, sharing and KPI card pages; they document general sharing but no custom-KPI-specific behavior.

claims.claim: No licence specific to custom KPIs is published.

claims.claim: Each Power Automate Premium licence adds 50 MB of process mining capacity to the tenant pool.

claims.claim: Capacity accumulated from Premium licences is capped at 100 GB.
claims.quote: When you reach 100 GB, you need to purchase the Power Automate Process Mining add-on to process more data.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a separate custom-KPI price, meter or rule for capacity consumed by creating or evaluating one.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate process intelligence custom KPIs licensing capacity meter billing. Opened overview licensing and KPI card pages; read pay-as-you-go meters search excerpts. No custom-KPI charge or evaluation-capacity rule found.

claims.claim: Process mining requires a Power Platform environment with a Dataverse database and the applicable licences or trials.
claims.quote: The required licenses or trials depending on the capabilities you want access to. A Microsoft Power Platform environment with a Microsoft Dataverse database.

claims.claim: Dataverse storage is a related process mining cost consideration.
claims.quote: Depending on the size of the process data you import, you might run out of Dataverse storage capacity. If this happens, ask your admin about purchasing more storage capacity

claims.claim: Feature-specific rollout mechanics beyond the roadmap target and status are not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate process intelligence custom KPIs public tabs permissions rollout; "process intelligence" "custom KPIs". Opened studio overview and KPI card pages; no feature-specific rollout mechanism or window found.

claims.claim: Duplicate tab copies the tab with all its cards and layout.
claims.quote: Duplicate tab: Create a copy of the tab with all its cards and layout.

claims.claim: The cited sharing page gives Environments > environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Users > user > Reassign records.
claims.quote: Sign in to Power Platform admin center. Select the environment where the process is located. On the command bar, select Settings. Under Users + permissions, select Users.
claims.fix: Replace the path in front matter and the table with 'environment > Settings > Users + permissions > Users > user > Reassign records'. The cited page starts at the linked admin center environment list and does not specify an Environments navigation step.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and prose; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The PM Inferred Task reference documents Assign through PATCH /msdyn_pminferredtasks(<msdyn_pminferredtaskid>) updating ownerid.
claims.quote: Assign ... PATCH /msdyn_pminferredtasks(msdyn_pminferredtaskid) Update the ownerid property.

claims.claim: A reassignment recipient needs appropriate privileges on the entities associated with the transferred records.
claims.quote: The target user should have the appropriate privileges on the different entities associated with the transferred records.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: Environment Maker is sufficient for the target user of a reassigned process mining process.
claims.quote: For process mining process, giving the Environment Maker role is sufficient.

claims.claim: Process mining access follows environment security and Dataverse security roles.
claims.quote: The process mining capability relies on environment security and Microsoft Dataverse security roles and privileges to grant access to its features in Power Automate.

claims.claim: No separate control specifically restricting who defines custom KPIs is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate process intelligence custom KPI enable disable admin restrict security roles Dataverse API; "process intelligence" custom KPIs "admin" "pac" PowerShell. Opened security and KPI pages; no separate KPI-authoring restriction found.

claims.claim: Because security and sharing pages do not mention custom KPIs, Microsoft has not confirmed that these controls apply to them.
claims.quote: The process mining capability relies on environment security and Microsoft Dataverse security roles and privileges to grant access to its features in Power Automate.
claims.fix: Replace the final sentence with 'Process mining access is governed by environment security and Dataverse roles and privileges; Microsoft has not documented a permission specifically for creating or editing custom KPIs.' Keep the narrower uncertainty about custom-KPI behavior on shared tabs.

claims.claim: Other users are unaffected even though metric edits can alter figures those users rely on.
claims.quote: impact: ... other users are unaffected. / Change & support: ... one maker's change can alter figures other people rely on.
claims.fix: Remove '; other users are unaffected' from the impact rationale. Keep the medium impact rating and the supported description of makers and analysts seeing the editor and metrics.

claims.claim: Reassign records can be used to transfer ownership after an employee leaves.
claims.quote: In the Assign to field, use the dropdown menu to assign all the records to either the administrator or another user.
claims.fix: Append to the control note and the After rollout reassignment instruction: 'Reassign records transfers all of the selected user's records, not just one process.' The current wording omits this important scope qualification.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes defining, editing and displaying metrics, without describing a new connector or autonomous action.
claims.quote: Custom metric creation ... Editing and management ... Native visualization support ... Business-specific measurements ... Reusability

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to check Make public, but that control has no row in the controls table.
claims.quote: Check how Make public treats a tab that holds a custom KPI before using it / The controls table contains only Which user owns a process mining process.
claims.fix: The At rollout step 'Check how Make public treats a tab that holds a custom KPI before using it' has no corresponding control row. Remove this duplicate checklist bullet; the same test advice already appears under Risk assessment: Data exposure.

claims.claim: Process mining users can hold either Power Automate Premium or the Process Mining add-on.
claims.quote: The Process Mining add-on is a tenant-wide license that's available for the Power Automate Premium license. ... An extra 100 GB of process mining capacity to the capacity pool, which users with the Power Automate Premium license can use.
claims.fix: Replace the licence-check bullet with 'Confirm which users hold Power Automate Premium and whether the tenant has the Process Mining add-on so that any capacity effect can be traced later.' The add-on is tenant-wide additional capacity, not an alternative user licence.
